proof_body:
by
  intro V P _ _ _ _ A B C h
  have h1 : dist A C < dist A B + dist B C :=
    dist_lt_dist_add_dist_iff.mpr fun hw => h hw.collinear
  have h2 : dist B C < dist B A + dist A C :=
    dist_lt_dist_add_dist_iff.mpr fun hw => h (by have := hw.collinear; rwa [Set.insert_comm] at this)
  have h3 : dist A B < dist A C + dist C B :=
    dist_lt_dist_add_dist_iff.mpr fun hw => h (by have := hw.collinear; rwa [Set.pair_comm] at this)
  rw [dist_comm B A] at h2
  rw [dist_comm C B] at h3
  refine ⟨h1, abs_lt.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩⟩
target_source: ∀ (V P : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] (A B C : P), ¬Collinear ℝ ({A, B, C} : Set P) → dist A C < dist A B + dist B C ∧ |dist A B - dist B C| < dist A C
